contentful: Contentful is a headless content platform: content is modelled once and delivered to websites, apps and other channels through APIs. Locales are part of every content model, so each field can hold one value per language.
sanity: Sanity is a headless content platform with Sanity Studio, an editing environment teams configure in code. Translations are usually stored per document or per field, depending on how the project is set up.
sitecore: Sitecore is an enterprise digital experience platform used by large companies for websites, personalisation and commerce. Content items have versions per language, managed in its editors.
rws-tridion: RWS Tridion is an enterprise content management family: Tridion Sites for websites and Tridion Docs for structured technical content. It is used by organisations that publish in many languages.
opentext: OpenText offers enterprise content management for documents, web content and records, used widely in large and regulated organisations.
plytix: Plytix is a product information management (PIM) system for small and mid-sized brands: product data, images and channel feeds in one place.
salesforce-marketing-cloud: Salesforce Marketing Cloud is a marketing automation platform for email, mobile messaging and customer journeys, part of the Salesforce ecosystem.
figma: Figma is a collaborative design tool for interfaces, websites and marketing material. Designs are shared and edited in the browser by the whole team.
atlassian-confluence: Confluence by Atlassian is a team wiki for documentation, knowledge bases and internal communication.
madcap-flare: MadCap Flare is an authoring tool for technical documentation: topics and snippets are written once and published as online help, PDF and other formats.
madcap-ixia-ccms: IXIA CCMS by MadCap is a component content management system for DITA-based technical documentation.
paligo: Paligo is a cloud-based component content management system for technical documentation, built on structured, reusable topics.
quanos: Quanos SCHEMA ST4 is a component content management system for technical documentation, widely used by manufacturers in German-speaking countries.
kovai-document360: Document360 by Kovai is a knowledge base platform for product documentation and help centres, with built-in multilingual support.
veeva-vault: Veeva Vault is a cloud content management platform for life sciences companies, used for regulated documents, quality and medical content.
articulate: Articulate makes e-learning authoring tools: Rise for responsive online courses and Storyline for interactive modules.
microsoft-sharepoint: Microsoft SharePoint is the intranet and document platform of Microsoft 365, used for team sites, pages and shared files.
microsoft-365: Microsoft 365 is Microsoft's office suite in the cloud, with Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Teams.
google-docs: Google Docs is the online word processor of Google Workspace, for writing and editing documents together in the browser.
zendesk: Zendesk is a customer service platform with ticketing, a Help Center for self-service articles, and macros for standard replies.
freshworks-freshdesk: Freshdesk by Freshworks is a customer support platform with ticketing and a knowledge base for self-service.
intercom: Intercom is a customer service platform with messaging, an AI agent and a Help Center for articles.
servicenow: ServiceNow is a platform for IT, employee and customer service workflows, with knowledge bases and service catalogues.
salesforce-service-cloud: Salesforce Service Cloud is Salesforce's customer service application: cases, replies, email templates and service channels.
salesforce-knowledge: Salesforce Knowledge is the knowledge base of Salesforce, with articles for agents and customer self-service.
atlassian-jira: Jira by Atlassian is a work management tool for software and business teams: issues, projects and boards.
atlassian-trello: Trello by Atlassian organises work on boards, lists and cards.
monday-com: monday.com is a work management platform for projects, workflows and team collaboration.
adobe-workfront: Adobe Workfront is an enterprise work management platform, often used by marketing teams to plan projects and route content for review.
notion: Notion is a workspace for notes, documents, wikis and project databases.
salesforce-slack: Slack, part of Salesforce, is a messaging platform for teams, organised in channels.
github: GitHub is the most widely used platform for hosting code with Git, with pull requests, reviews and automation.
gitlab: GitLab is a DevOps platform for hosting code with Git, with merge requests and built-in CI/CD.
atlassian-bitbucket: Bitbucket by Atlassian hosts Git repositories, with pull requests and pipelines, closely integrated with Jira.
git: Git is the version control system most software is developed with. App and website texts often live in its repositories as resource files.
n8n: n8n is a workflow automation tool that connects apps and services with nodes, as a cloud service or self-hosted.
blackbird: Blackbird is an orchestration platform for localization workflows that connects content systems, translation tools and AI.
belazy: BeLazy automates translation project management by connecting translation management systems and vendor portals.
uipath: UiPath is an automation platform for software robots and AI agents that take over repetitive business processes.
rws-trados-studio: Trados Studio by RWS is the most widely used desktop CAT tool among professional translators, with translation memories and terminology.
rws-multiterm: MultiTerm by RWS is a terminology management tool that works with Trados Studio and other RWS products.
kaleidoscope-quickterm: Quickterm by Kaleidoscope is an enterprise terminology management system with workflows for proposing, approving and sharing terms.
interverbum-termweb: TermWeb by Interverbum is a web-based terminology management system for companies.
snowflake: Snowflake is a cloud data platform for data warehousing, data sharing and analytics.
microsoft-power-bi: Microsoft Power BI is a business intelligence tool for interactive reports and dashboards.
salesforce-tableau: Tableau, part of Salesforce, is a visual analytics platform for exploring data and building dashboards.
google-cloud-looker: Looker by Google Cloud is a business intelligence platform for governed metrics, reports and embedded analytics.
google-gemini: Gemini is Google's AI assistant, available on the web, in Android and in Google Workspace.
mistral-ai: Mistral AI is a French AI company; its assistant Le Chat and its models are used by companies across Europe.
meta-llama: Llama is a family of open-weight language models by Meta that companies run in their own applications.
cohere-command: Command is Cohere's family of language models for business applications such as agents and search.
cohere-aya: Aya is Cohere's family of multilingual language models, built to cover many languages.
xai-grok: Grok is the AI assistant by xAI, available on the web, in apps and in X.
snowflake-cowork: Snowflake CoWork is Snowflake's personal work agent for knowledge workers, answering questions and taking actions grounded in the company's governed data.
